title: Cambodia
subtitle: Apparel sourcing: costs and risks
meta: Edition of 16 November 2026. Series to {series}, scores of 1 November in the appendix.
excerpt: Cambodia ends 2026 with its exports growing and its economy slowing. Garment, footwear and travel goods shipments rose 7.4% to USD 14.4 billion in ten months and total exports 20%, with the United States taking 44% of them at a 27% duty; growth has fallen to about 3%, reserves lost USD 5.3 billion between February and September, bad loans reached 9.6% of the book, and the fuel bill of the war in the Gulf is paid by a subsidy of more than USD 600 million.
